entries.dd448b8e40dc1a4a: A single-segment business that manufactures and sells diamond tools (including CBN tools and whetstones) and carries out ancillary operations. The company and 15 consolidated subsidiaries and two equity-method affiliates form the group, with revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 of ¥41,983 million and 2,040 consolidated employees. In Japan, Yamanashi Asahi Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd. supplies products to the company, and Koremura Asahi Diamond Industrial Co., Ltd. mainly sells in Japan and the Asia-Oceania region. Overseas, it has manufacturing and sales subsidiaries and sales subsidiaries in Europe, Asia-Oceania, North America and Central America.
